status: PRE_BODY_APPROVED protocol; implemented runner, source/binary/dependency freeze and independent pre-execution review pending
budget_accounting: One monotonic elapsed interval per result-bearing child from launch through evidence collection; sequential physical children only. Sum controls+reference+stability+candidate diagnostic+timing, including startup/parse overhead for limits although excluded from sample timing. Deny launch after global/deadline exhaustion; watchdog kills at earliest cap and preserves partial as timeout, never a completed timing.
balance: A alternates FULL/REDUCED within matched case/profile pairs; B alternates ascending/descending new cadence order. No measurement-driven reorder. Each cell completes diagnostic then six consecutive fixed four-day batches; between-cell pairing is balanced, not six interleaved cross-arm pairs.

per_cell.freshness: Initialize each day from exact fixed case bits; carry accepted M/H and diagnostic state across every support within that day, never reset at parent boundaries. No warmup days or extra physical cases. Only diagnostic-completing cells enter timing. Failure during any timed day ends the cell; retain earlier full batches but label timing coverage incomplete.

clock_protocol.cpu: Linux per-process CPUCLOCK_SCHED via clock_gettime_ns(((~pid)<<3)|2), verify reported PID equals measured child and record clock_getres; existing projection-cache-timing.py protocol is the reference mechanism, not an execution target
clock_protocol.wall: time.perf_counter_ns() / CLOCK_MONOTONIC; retain start/end ns per batch
clock_protocol.sequence: After child fixture parse and READY handshake, sample CPU then wall; send RUN_FRESH_DAYS 4; child executes four complete freshly initialized days retaining consumed outcome data and emits END only; sample wall then CPU. DUMP and JSON formatting/parent validation follow outside interval. No child exit until clocks sampled. Record every CPU/wall sample; no resampling or overhead subtraction.
clock_protocol.included: day initialization, every accepted/rejected solve/evaluator/derivative/factor, hydraulics, materialization, all diagnostic state updates and output storage
clock_protocol.excluded: build, process startup, fixture parsing before READY, JSON formatting and checks after END
clock_protocol.observation_overhead: command read, END write, result retention, parent IPC and scheduling are unavoidably included; explicitly report without subtraction
clock_protocol.checks: Timed day outcome entire numerical state/flux/integral/transition/support trace digest must equal same-cell diagnostic outcome exactly under identical settings. Hash formation after END from retained operands, no hidden solve. Different FULL/REDUCED trajectories are not required bit-identical.

failure_policy.numerical_domain_failure: record first failure and actual intervals; end cell; other safe scheduled cells continue
failure_policy.reference_failure: retain timing/completion but mark reference accuracy unresolved; safe other profiles continue
failure_policy.B_eligibility: For each case/profile, reduced60 must complete. Otherwise all corresponding new cadences unavailable without changing method.
failure_policy.retry: No valid-negative/timeout/noisy timing retry. At most one affected-work replay after independently verified implementation/recording defect; retain first evidence. Shared correction invalidating more work than allowed stops campaign.

host_build.toolchain: rustc1.95.0 commit59807616e1fa2540724bfbac14d7976d7e4a3860 LLVM21.1.8 via repository locked Nix environment
host_build.optional_tracing: off during timing; no extra physical tracing replay
host_build.concurrency: No concurrent heavy builds/tests or other physical cells; record process snapshots before/after measurement without claiming continuous surveillance
host_build.freeze: Exact detached source/input/protocol, external support files, Cargo.lock/flake.lock/toolchain/config and binary digests before physical controls/cells; no writer mutation during validation/measurement. Build depfile audit closes actual dependencies; deny mismatch before/after commands.

reference_order: One FULL/P0 60s reference per case and its one explicitly defined stricter stability check, before candidate sweep. Reference source/settings must match A FULL/P0 to reuse its outputs as candidate diagnostic; timing still fresh. No duplicate strict physical diagnostic when reused.
result_reporting: Separate A matched-profile reduction ratios and within-formulation tolerance contrasts; B matched-profile cadence and strict-reference total differences. Missing/failed cells have no invented ratio. Retain all24 day outcomes per completed timing cell and six CPU/wall samples, medians/ranges, dimensional outputs, independent integrals and coverage; column-day costs never whole-OFE-day pass.
